name: Exhilaration of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
description:
Legend has it that long ago, countless casks of fine wine were poured into a frozen lake.
Some say the wine was intended as wartime provisions, which had to be destroyed after some mishap. Others say a certain Grand Duke of the Domovoy had lost a bet to the ruler of the Water Imps.
Only when unquenchable azure hellflame spread across the lake, and the foes below writhed in choking waves, did they come to understand:
In the hands of the people well versed in the turning of the world, water itself could burn, and even the sweetest nectar could prove deadlier than poison.

items.name: Intoxication of the Cellared Spiritual Nectar
